title: Reducers execute inside the Reactor — whichever Reactor processes the action — never in Connect's UI or Switchboard's API layer
content:
"Where does this actually run?" is the question that unlocks the rest of the stack, and for reducers the answer is unambiguous: inside the Reactor, and specifically inside whichever Reactor processes the action.

## The three tempting wrong answers

**"Inside Connect, because that's where the user is."** Connect is a host that embeds a Reactor. The user's keystroke becomes an action, Connect dispatches it, and the reducer runs in the embedded engine — not in Connect's React tree.

**"Inside Switchboard, because it manages the API."** Switchboard hosts a server-side Reactor, but its GraphQL and MCP layer is a surface, not an execution site. A mutation resolver dispatches; the Reactor reduces.

**"On the DocSync layer, as part of conflict resolution."** DocSync moves operations between Reactors. Reducers run *before* that — they are what produce the operations DocSync then transports. Nothing on the wire re-runs a reducer as part of merging.

## The mental model

Hosts dispatch, the Reactor reduces. Draw the boundary once and every subsequent question answers itself: an editor cannot "call the reducer," because it has no reducer to call — it hands an action across the boundary and reads back derived state. A subgraph resolver is in the same position. Both are clients of the engine.

## Why it matters

Because the reducer runs in exactly one place per action, its purity has teeth. The same action dispatched from a browser editor and from a server-side integration produces the same operation, because it is reduced by the same code in the same kind of engine. Validation you put in a reducer therefore holds no matter which surface fired the action — you cannot bypass it by going around the UI to the API. Conversely, business logic placed in an editor or a resolver holds only for that surface, which is why it belongs in the reducer instead.

_Source: apps/academy/docs/academy/02-Learn/02-architecture/01-the-big-picture.mdx (Powerhouse v6.2.2-dev.45)._
description: Connect and Switchboard only dispatch; the local Reactor runs the reducer. DocSync transports the resulting operations rather than running reducers itself.
